src: singleton blue marker pixels on the background
path: straight horizontal or vertical sightline toward the unique nearest aligned red 2x2 block, stopping at the adjacent ring cell; markers with no clear sightline do not move
trajectory: move each selected marker pixel to its stopping cell
dst: one-cell ring around the matched red 2x2 block
transform: clear moved marker sources and keep red 2x2 blocks and unmoved marker pixels unchanged
multi_step: choose nearest clear aligned blocks before moving; a lower-row marker left of a block stays fixed when that block already has selected vertical markers above and below
